zh.title: 美國航空航機手提電腦起火 4人輕微灼傷安全降落
zh.summary: 美國航空客機手提電腦起火；機組人員撲滅火勢；降落達拉斯至少4人灼傷
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）2398號航班於2026年8月21日由亞特蘭大（ATL）飛往達拉斯-沃斯堡（DFW）途中，客艙內發生手提電腦電池起火事故。飛行員向空中交通管制通報客艙後方出現煙霧，機組人員隨後在空中成功撲滅火勢。
涉事機型為空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）。該航班隨後順利降落達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場並滑行至指定登機門，醫療人員已在現場戒備。事故造成至少4人受輕微灼傷，其中至少1名乘客在降落後接受醫療處置，無人需要住院治療。

en.title: Laptop Fire Onboard American Airlines Flight Leaves at Least Four Injured
en.summary: American Airlines flight 2398 landed safely in Dallas after a laptop battery fire injured four people.
body: On August 21, 2026, American Airlines flight 2398 operating from Atlanta (ATL) to Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) experienced an in-flight laptop battery fire. The flight crew reported smoke in the rear section of the cabin to air traffic control, and the cabin crew successfully extinguished the fire onboard.

The aircraft, an Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321), landed at Dallas-Fort Worth without further incident and taxied to its assigned gate, where medical personnel were waiting. At least four people suffered minor burns in the incident. At least one passenger received medical attention upon arrival in Texas, though no hospitalization was required.

zh.title: 薩博公開A3-001無人戰鬥航空系統概念
zh.summary: 薩博發表A3-001無人戰鬥系統概念；預計2030年前進行示範機首飛。
body: 瑞典航太與國防企業薩博於2026年8月22日發表新型無人戰鬥航空系統概念機「A3-001」。該款概念機是在瑞典林雪平附近的馬爾門空軍基地舉行的銀禧航空展上公開亮相，該展覽旨在慶祝瑞典空軍成立100週年。
A3-001旨在高風險及爭議性環境中，與獅鷲E型（Gripen E）等有人戰鬥機協同作戰，而非取代有人戰機。該機型具備低可偵測性與高自主性，任務範疇涵蓋電子戰、壓制敵方防空系統以及精準打擊。
薩博於展覽現場展示了A3-001的全尺寸模型。薩博先進計畫業務負責人尼爾森（Peter Nilsson）表示，該概念代表薩博對2030年代中期以後建構系統的願景，並計畫於2030年前試飛具備戰鬥機特性的無人示範機。

en.title: Saab Unveils A3-001 Uncrewed Combat Air System Concept in Sweden
en.summary: Saab unveiled its A3-001 uncrewed combat air system concept in Sweden, planning test flights before 2030.
body: Swedish aerospace and defense company Saab unveiled a new uncrewed combat air system concept named A3-001 on August 22, 2026. The concept was publicly presented at the Jubilee Air Show, held at Malmen Air Base near Linköping, Sweden, to mark the 100th anniversary of the Swedish Air Force.

The A3-001 platform is designed to operate alongside manned fighters, such as Saab's Gripen E, in high-risk and contested environments. Featuring low observability and autonomous capabilities, the aircraft is intended for electronic warfare, suppression of enemy air defense, and precision strike missions.

Saab displayed a full-scale mockup at the air show. Peter Nilsson, head of Advanced Programs at Saab, stated that the concept represents a vision for systems from the mid-2030s onwards, with plans to fly uncrewed demonstrators before 2030.
